user.title: Connect a Bluetooth Evonic fire
user.description: Requires a local Linux Bluetooth adapter and HCI monitor permissions. Bluetooth proxies are unsupported. Setup reads status only. Power, target temperature, Low/High and brightness controls are included. Temperature, heat-level and brightness changes require the fire to be on.

error.invalid_address: Enter a Bluetooth address in AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF format.
error.monitor_unavailable: Home Assistant Core cannot open the Linux Bluetooth monitor. No fire commands were sent.
error.no_local_adapter: The fire is not visible through a local Linux Bluetooth adapter. Disconnect the phone app and check Bluetooth range.
